name: LG Evap/Condenser Fan Supply Voltage
purpose: Verify LG BLDC fan drive voltage in Test Mode 1 at main PCB CON3.
failureModes: Below 11.4 V with fan commanded — motor or PCB output fault
0 V or stuck 5 V on feedback/PWM lines — fan motor or main PCB
testingTips: LRMVS3006: push test button once on main PCB for Test Mode 1 (all fans on)
F-fan CON3 16–13; R-fan 28–25; C-fan 12–9; I-fan 24–21 — all vs pin 25/13/9/21 GND

name: LG Defrost Heater Supply Voltage (Test Mode 3)
purpose: Confirm main PCB energizes defrost heater during forced defrost (Test Mode 3).
failureModes: No 112–116 V at heater — PCB relay or Fuse-M open
Voltage present but no heat — open heater element
testingTips: Test button ×3 on main PCB → 33 33 display = forced defrost
F defrost CON9 pin 5–13; R defrost pin 7–13 vs neutral

name: LG Freezer Defrost Heater Resistance
purpose: LG LRMVS3006 freezer defrost heater and Fuse-M check.
failureModes: Fuse-M should read 0 Ω — open = blown
testingTips: Power disconnected; F dH flow also references 42–50 Ω at CON9 in some test points — verify both heater legs

name: LG Fresh-Food Defrost Heater Resistance
purpose: LG refrigerator compartment defrost heater (r dH path).
failureModes: Open heater — r dH after failed defrost cycle
testingTips: CON9 pin 7–13 heater circuit; Test Mode 3 for voltage confirmation
